自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始仰望星空以来，[From.GetName]就一直是一个纯真的梦幻，一个充满了我们的期待的地方，一个新的家园。可悲的是，随着我们的望远镜的发展，我们意识到这颗行星可能是一个潮汐锁定、万物冰封的地狱——这一假说已由我们今天的发现而彻底证实。

然而希望仍然存在，这个世界存在着作为一个宜居行星而言所必需的一切因素。我们或许只需要轻轻推上一把……
texts.en:
For as long as we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been able to look to the stars for new homes, [From.GetName] has been a naive dream: a place we would look to with optimism; a new home. Sadly as our telescopes got better, we realized that the planet would probably be a tidally locked, frozen hellscape - a theory which we have confirmed today.

There is hope, however; this world has all the building blocks necessary for a habitable planet. It might just need a slight push...
